GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders and annual-report splits are not public for an LLP and were not accessible: volza.com, eximpedia.app, trademo.com and thecompanycheck.com all returned HTTP 403 on fetch, and web_search returned no results (searx connection refused) during this session. One indirect domestic-market signal only: the Nepal lane (Raxaul -> Birgunj, 2025-10-12) shows a buyer named SANSKAR SUPPLIERS, but that is still a cross-border shipment, not an Indian domestic sale.
note: Export activity is factually confirmed by dated customs/B-L records, not by website claims: vitrified tiles HS 69072100 shipped from Mundra to Taiwan (Taichung 2026-01-10, Kaohsiung 2026-01-06 and 2025-10-01) and from Raxaul to Birgunj, Nepal (2025-10-12), with BOL numbers 8656898, 8528628, 1546064 and 5959942. Declared HS 690721 matches the observed export HS 69072100, so no HS correction is needed. The company also imports consumables (diamond rollers, HS 68042190) from Foshan, China, which is consistent with an own manufacturing operation rather than pure trading, though the manufacturer/trader role is outside this check.
